data.title: Bitcoin ETFs Lose $2.1 Billion in November as Outflow Streak Hits Seven Days
data.description: Spot Bitcoin ETFs shed $185.4 million on Friday, their seventh straight day of outflows, pushing November losses to about $2.1 billion as Bitcoin fell toward $64,000.
